text: Dre. Where is my lunch?
What lunch?
The lunch in the fridge. My bag. My name on it. In Sharpie. Two times.
Man, I ain't seen no bag.
There's barbecue sauce on your eyebrow.
That's my barbecue sauce.
You don't bring lunch, Dre. You have never brought lunch. Not one time in three years.
I'm trying something new. Meal prep.
Meal prep? That's my mama's chicken. She cut the crust off my sandwich, because I asked her to. And your sandwich? No crust.
A lot of people cut the crust off.
Your napkin says, Skip, have a good day. Love, Mama.
She seem real sweet.
Bro!
Look. It was in the fridge. The fridge is for everybody. That's the rules.
There's no fridge rules! Who told you that?
It's on the paper. On the door.
The paper says, clean out your old food on Friday. It's Tuesday!
I was getting a head start.
You ate my chicken, my sandwich, and my pudding cup.
The pudding was mid, though.
Mid?! So you ate it, and then you gave it a review?
I'm just being honest. Two stars.
You owe me lunch.
Bet. I got you Friday.
No. Not Friday. Last Friday you paid me forty dollars.
Right. And we good.
Hold up. Where did that forty dollars come from?
You remember. You lost your wallet. Thursday.
Yeah.
I found it.
So you used my own money, to pay me back?
Technically, I paid you back. You're welcome.
So. What you bringing for lunch tomorrow.
